metadata.title: छत्तीसगढ़ के आदिवासियों के बारे में आपको क्या याद है? What you remember about Chhattisgarh Adivasis?
metadata.description: Main Bhi Bharat has done a series from Bilaspur, Korba and Surguja a few weeks back. In this series we met many adivasi groups including some PVTGs. Today in Main Bhi Bharat Quiz, we will ask you one question from this series. The people who will send a right answer will get a lovely gift from Team Main Bhi Bharat.   #quiz
